title: Construct paired microreversible χe energy-conserving collision quartets with full Pauli and finite SM energy, avoiding ad hoc L symmetrization
objective: The real 5D χe equilibrium event graph shows positivity but fails finite-bin detailed balance and inflates linear response by Jensen variance. Derive a discretization where each 2→2 χ+e↔χ'+e' rate is paired at the identical total χ/e energy and phase-space weight. Preserve both χ and electron charges, total energy and Pauli bounds without post-hoc projection that modifies microphysics. Only then integrate physical time-dependent finite SM bath and BEST Yukawa/Bose production.
prerequisites: Read AGENTS.md and CONTINUOUS-RESEARCH-SPEC.md; GOAL/STATE/NEXT_ACTION/EVIDENCE/BACKLOG and latest PR HEAD/CI
Check CI for c81a525, 32c0a32 and this checkpoint; repair failures before a new scientific claim

Read kinetics/MICROPHYSICAL-BIN-GRAPH-AUDIT.md, microphysical_equilibrium_graph.py, BIN-LOCAL-DETAILED-BALANCE.md, FINITE-BIN-RECOIL-PROJECTION-CONTROL.md, prior full 5D weak/nonlinear source, finite-bath pairs and numerical scans
hypotheses_to_falsify: A uniform common-energy lattice of χ and e occupations with event quartets satisfying Ei+ea=Ej+eb may yield exact microreversible Pauli rates at finite grid spacing without a forced L symmetrization; test against continuous 5D amplitudes and recoil

Direct E′ barycentric interpolation preserves first moment but adds exactly nonnegative variance to quadratic response; test whether physical quartet co-refinement removes it with controlled O(width²)
A reversible reference-T graph (L+L.T)/2 cannot be treated as a fully microscopic arbitrary-f/variable-T collision even if Pauli, entropy and number hold within a reduced network
steps: Derive energy-lattice χ and e state capacities and positive quadrature weights for collision quartets i,a↔j,b with equal center total energies. Test actual matrix element |M|² and spin counts; handle electron/neutrino and backreaction consistently
Independent small-grid forward/reverse Pauli source for every quartet: common-T FD null for arbitrary independent μχ, μe without post-hoc symmetrization; number χ/e and total energy charge ledgers

Compare quartet energy relaxation Dirichlet and nonlinear Q against continuous 5D χe source, electron recoil and strong-vs-weak; n_q, n_k, angular, cutoff convergence. Retain any systematic projection/aliasing as negative result

Feed physically derived rates into positivity-preserving implicit finite bath integrator, recomputing electron occupancy and Pauli at each bath temperature. Test entropy and temporal convergence; no hidden thermal reservoir

Add EW-gauge-consistent lepton channels/UV mediator, thermal masses, temperature-dependent gstar before FRW and pinned BEST Bose 1↔2; long 86-eV freezeout/CLASS only with independently validated physics
After each stage update detailed checkpoint/evidence and negative results, commit/push fast forward, start next best science task
acceptance: Nonzero Γ from actual 5D χe matrix element for energy-matched paired processes without post-hoc symmetrization
Independent local detailed balance/Pauli/entropy and both χ/e particle number plus energy ledgers
Direct numerical comparison with true 5D weak/strong moments to a quantified convergence tolerance
Actual variable-T finite-bath dynamics with positive occupancies and consistent SM heat/entropy
No physical 86-eV relic, BEC, ΩDM, frozen f(q), CLASS-ready until full validation
scope: public branch and draft PR only; no force/merge main, no user PC or Computer Use without explicit approval; compact GitHub Actions
fallback: If physically paired grid cannot be made with all scattering support, present a rigorously controlled restricted quartet and publish the truncation/aliasing as a negative result rather than invent a gamma.
